summary: Iteration 12 - tested the two NEW features (Excel import for Guru/Siswa + per-teacher login accounts with create/reset/cascade-delete) end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_teacher_accounts_import.py - 21/21 passed (imports, header validation, invalid file, duplicate skip, invalid class skipped with per-row error, account create, duplicate username 400, second account 400, short password 422, reset password rotation, cascade delete on teacher delete, rename syncs account name, auth guards 401/403, classes/subjects CRUD regression, dashboard/reports/schedules 200). Frontend: full Playwright E2E - legacy 'guru'/'Guru123!' rejected, admin login (name 'admin'), Impor Excel (accept .xlsx,.xls) on Kelola Guru imported 2 teachers with toast 'Guru: 2 ditambahkan' and list auto-refreshed, Kelola Siswa import added valid 7A row and skipped invalid class row (toast 'Siswa: 1 ditambahkan, 1 dilewati'), inline account form (username+password) created account -> toast 'Akun login guru berhasil dibuat' + row subtitle became 'Username: xxx', duplicate username showed toast 'Username sudah digunakan' and second teacher stayed without account, logout+login as new teacher worked (role Guru, teacher's name), reset-password form correctly hides username field -> toast 'Password guru berhasil diperbarui', old password rejected / new accepted, deleting the teacher removed the row and the login no longer works (cascade). Regression on Kelola Kelas & Kelola Mapel (add/edit/delete, no import button) and Dashboard all fine. Auth playbook checks: bcrypt hashes are $2b$12$, httpOnly+secure cookie set on login, CORS uses explicit origin with allow_credentials, seed only seeds Admin and removes the shared 'guru' user. All test data created by me was cleaned up.

minor.issue: No brute-force protection / rate limiting or account lockout - 6+ consecutive wrong passwords still allowed and the valid login works right after. Playbook expects lockout after 5 failures.

ui_bugs.issue: The active page is not reset on logout/login. If an Admin is on 'Kelola Guru' (or any Administration page), clicks Keluar and a Guru logs in from the same tab, the Guru is shown the full Admin master-data page (Impor Excel, key/edit/delete buttons for every teacher) even though the Administration nav section is hidden. Backend still returns 403 for writes, so no data can be changed, but the admin-only UI is exposed. Fix: reset active to 'dashboard' on logout and/or when the logged-in user role is not Admin.

action_items: Reset the active view to Dashboard on logout/login so a Guru never lands on an Admin master-data page (see ui_bugs).

Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md - it still documents the deleted shared account 'guru'/'Guru123!' and the old email-based note; it must state that teacher accounts are created by Admin per teacher.
Optional/security: consider simple login attempt throttling (no lockout currently).
Optional/code-review: remove the hardcoded preview URL fallback in the CORS allow_origins (server.py:629) - env var should be required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:629 CORSMiddleware uses a hardcoded preview URL as fallback for FRONTEND_URL - violates the no-hardcoded-URL rule; fail fast instead.

Excel import silently ignores rows with blank name (not counted in imported or skipped), so the toast counts can be lower than the number of file rows - consider reporting them as skipped for transparency.
App.js is a single very large file (>700 lines with dense one-line components); Master/Login/Reports should be split into modules for maintainability.

resetTeacherPassword does not call loadMasters (fine today since nothing visible changes) but createTeacherAccount does - keep behaviour consistent if the row ever shows account metadata like 'last reset'.

IMPORTANT: the live user edits master data concurrently in this preview - teacher/student lists change between runs, so always filter by your own unique prefix instead of asserting absolute counts. Only open item: active-view not reset on logout/login (Guru sees Admin page).
rca_of_the_issue: Role/view leak: App.js keeps `active` in component state and only clears `user`/`loggedIn` on logout; the Administration nav items are conditionally rendered on role but the page body is rendered purely from `active`, so after a Guru logs in in the same tab the previously selected admin page (e.g. Kelola Guru) keeps rendering. Repro: login admin -> Kelola Guru -> Keluar -> login with a teacher account -> admin master page is displayed. Mitigation: setActive('dashboard') in the logout handler and guard admin views with user.role === 'Admin'.
